findings.title: Redundant @@index([orderId]) on OrderItem
findings.problem: The composite @@unique([orderId, itemId]) already materializes a btree index led by orderId, so the standalone @@index([orderId]) adds write cost with no read benefit.
findings.fix: Kept deliberately per acceptance criterion #3 and annotated with a schema comment explaining the redundancy. If ever revisited, drop @@index([orderId]) and strike it from criterion #3. Non-blocking.

findings.title: Monetary precision @db.Decimal(12,2) is a choice beyond the bare spec
findings.where: schema money fields (price, unitPrice, subtotal, totalAmount, unitCost)
findings.problem: Spec says 'Decimal' without precision/scale; the design fixes (12,2) consistently across all five money fields.
findings.fix: Reasonable currency choice applied consistently (satisfies criterion #4). Confirm (12,2) covers the expected price range; no change required otherwise. Non-blocking.
